name: light_shafts
description: Light shafts: a dim fine lace in a dark void, straight shafts of light streaming out of its bright points away from one point, as through haze.
notes: Round one (078): triage group (9)'s light beams, wallhaven-398e39 the default; necromancer (scarlet_shafts) and wallhaven-396d7v (ice_shafts) as palette entries (tone only). The shafts are the post stage's new `rays` pass with a `center` (POST.md): the brightest 3% of the frame (the lit lace and the set's hair) casts light outwards from a point just above the middle, each sample taking the mean of the light behind it over 0.25 frame widths, so shafts stream out of the fractal's own bright lace. A first cut gathered 160 taps a stride apart and drew moire rings; the pass sums by doubling (a dozen one-tap passes), which skips no sample. Under it, fine stripe grain at density 24 from three loops masked to the set, the set's hair, a dark void, all at about a third of full so the shafts (strength 10) carry the picture: with the lace full (the lit_lace reading, strength 4) the lace led, the shafts read as background, and 22 of 35 location drafts missed the reference's p90 (the lace too bright). Nearest mode: hairline_rays (stroke-trap hairlines: curves, never straight); route two, the stroke trap's own lines laid on this stack (strokes), is in the picker beside the post-pass route. Readings: streak (a second pass: a horizontal two-spoke streak, 398e39's horizon), long (0.5), low (the point near the bottom edge), lit_lace, no_rays. A further reading puts necromancer on starburst_veils instead, as one long scarlet streak (two spokes at 150 degrees, length 0.4). Tone, round one: 20 of 35 scout drafts hold (all 12 kept seats), misses p90 on lace-dense seats; both entries miss (scarlet_shafts lifts the dark stack whole: no range; ice_shafts too black). Cost: 43.7 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at phoenix_2d843082 (maxiter 9,266), the shafts 2.0 s of it. Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 32 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (phoenix_fc131a7f, maxiter 4,930), under the 5-minute bar.
